entries.title: Psalms 3:1
segments: <<A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.>> Jehovah, how are mine adversaries increased! Many are they that rise up against me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:2
segments: Many there are that say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 3:3
segments: But thou, O Jehovah, art a shield about me; My glory and the lifter up of my head.

entries.title: Psalms 3:4
segments: I cry unto Jehovah with my voice, And he answereth me out of his holy hill. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 3:5
segments: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for Jehovah sustaineth me.

entries.title: Psalms 3:6
segments: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of the people That have set themselves against me round about.

entries.title: Psalms 3:7
segments: Arise, O Jehovah; save me, O my God: For thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; Thou hast broken the teeth of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 3:8
segments: Salvation belongeth unto Jehovah: Thy blessing be upon thy people. Selah
